parameters.cursor: * for page 1; page 1's meta.next_cursor for page 2

coverage_statement: The ten most-cited works in OpenAlex with at least one UC Berkeley-affiliated authorship, publication year 2024, and an abstract, as ranked on the retrieval date.
construction_notes: Both files keep the shape of an OpenAlex list reply: meta, results, group_by.
meta keeps count, db_response_time_ms, page, per_page, next_cursor and groups_count; the long x_query entry and cost_usd are left out.
Each work keeps id, doi, display_name, publication_year, cited_by_count, authorships and primary_topic.

Each authorship keeps author_position, the author's id, display_name and orcid, and each institution's id, display_name and country_code. Nothing was added or changed; OpenAlex lists at most 100 authorships per work in a list reply.
primary_topic keeps id, display_name, field and domain.
OpenAlex records change over time; these files are the fixed copy the workspace checks answers against.
